label: HPE Aruba Networking Instant On AP27 Outdoor Access Point (S1T37A)
description: HPE Aruba Networking Instant On AP27 (S1T37A) - dual-radio Wi-Fi 6 outdoor AP (IP67), 2x2 MIMO (574 Mbps 2.4 GHz + 1.2 Gbps 5 GHz). Single 1G BASE-T RJ45 uplink with 802.3af Class 4 / 802.3at PoE-in (14.6 W max).
